Persons are the built split's person keys (TotalSegmentator scans folded by content hash, no patient identifier; VinDr-SpineXR studies; BUU-LSPINE cases, two byte-identical pairs merged; NHANES II sample persons; COBRA2026 and C-ArmLSpine cases; Geneva, camera views of one phantom); hold = COBRA2026 cases held from every side. Images are the primary images of each source in the split's item map; other render roots (poses, styles, field-of-view cuts, film copies) re-render the same subjects and are not added. IQR = interquartile range.
^aNo age or sex released: C-ArmLSpine birth dates are a 2020-01-01 placeholder with no age tag; DeepFluoro age and sex tags are placeholders (022Y on the sawbones too); Geneva is one phantom; the Ljubljana release files carry none.
^bAudit repairs: CTSpinoPelvic1K record 0533, a truncated download rebuilt after the banks were frozen, is a person and a render here (802) and in no trained bank (801, Table 1); C-ArmLSpine's 299 spot exposures are the count after the case134 repair (Table 1 scores 296), its 301 sweep projections are the one rotational acquisition, and its second released sweep and the 18 Ljubljana frames are in no split root; COBRA2026 frames are counted once after the duplicate-root repair.
^cSubsets Table 1 counts: the 364 annotated NHANES II persons read 65 [62--69] (364) and 55.2 % female (364); the 145 COBRA2026 detector cases 66 [56--73] (115) and 54.7 % (75).
^d"Other" and "unknown" sex codes are excluded from the female denominator (CTSpinoPelvic1K 11, VinDr-SpineXR 68 studies, COBRA2026 120 of 692); CTSpinoPelvic1K ages of 89 are the TCIA top-code (31 records); NHANES II releases no demographics with its films, and the sequence number in each file name joins the survey's public-use anthropometry tape, whose sex code was checked against median standing height; VinDr-SpineXR releases no table, both tags were read from every image header and no study's images disagreed.
^eExcluded: keyed by the split but in no bank and in no reported number (FluoroCap panels are figures of published articles; 500 of Mendeley-716's 584 films re-encode BUU-LSPINE films).
^fNo Table 1 row; the release was not read for age or sex.
^gTransitional persons in the subtype table of 23 September 2026 that Table 2 was drawn from (test side in parentheses); after the semicolon, the transitional registry of 2026-09-24 over all truth tiers (read, two-labeller, single-labeller, morphology-only), whose labeller-tier calls are not certified persons and are not in Table 2.
